LESSON: WEATHER

Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade three
Subject: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
Strand: Natural Environment
Topic 2.1: Weather
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 10

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Weather, part of Natural Environment in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade three ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES.

Key inquiry question: How can we keep safe during unfavourable weather conditions?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Weather together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Values:
Social justice: learner enhances cooperation as they equitably share available learning resources when searching for information on

unfavourable weather conditions.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Life skills: learner makes right choices on the clothes to wear during unfavourable weather conditions.

Link to other Subjects:

Reading and listening to stories about appropriate responses to unfavourable weather conditions relates to active listening skills in

English Activities.

Approved support learning materials, pictures, digital devices with assistive technology, print weather charts, paints, painting brushes,
